question: Who is the unsupported lord at the center of the Śiva principle?
premises: In the middle is the unsupported reality.
There is the god of gods, indeed the unsupported one.
He bears his śakti in his lap and shines like a hundred crore suns.
inference: The center of the Śiva principle is occupied by Anāśrita Śiva, radiant and united with his śakti.
plain_english: In the middle there is the unsupported one: the god of gods, Anāśrita, bearing his śakti in his lap and shining with the radiance of a hundred crore suns.
